definitions.explanation: Serving as a prime example or embodiment of a category; exemplary.

examples.japanese: {富士山|ふじさん}は{日本|にほん}の{代表的|だいひょうてき}な{山|やま}だ。
examples.english: Mount Fuji is a representative mountain of Japan.

examples.japanese: これは{代表的|だいひょうてき}な{例|れい}の{一|ひと}つです。
examples.english: This is one of the representative examples.

examples.japanese: {寿司|すし}は{日本|にほん}の{代表的|だいひょうてき}な{料理|りょうり}だ。
examples.english: Sushi is a representative Japanese dish.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{代表|だいひょう} (representative) + {的|てき} (adjectival suffix)

NUANCE:
{代表的|だいひょうてき} emphasizes that something is a prime example or symbol of its category—not just typical, but exemplary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代表的|だいひょうてき}な{例|れい}: representative example
- {代表的|だいひょうてき}な{作品|さくひん}: representative work
- {代表的|だいひょうてき}な{人物|じんぶつ}: representative figure
- {代表的|だいひょうてき}な{料理|りょうり}: representative dish

RELATED TERMS:
- {代表|だいひょう}: representative, symbol
- {典型的|てんけいてき}: typical, archetypal
